paper_title: Novel cosmological bounds on thermally-produced axion-like particles
notes: Cosmological bound (CMB Planck 2018 + BAO) on thermally-produced ALP axion-photon coupling g_agamma vs axion mass, from Fig. 7 (blue diamonds, Planck+BAO, 95% CL). Marginalised overall bound g_agamma < 3.16e-8 GeV^-1. Fixed-mass grid: ma in {1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,0.1,1,3,10,30,100} eV. Numerical per-point values are read/estimated from the figure since exact table values are not given (only anchors: Planck+BAO+ACT gives 2.19e-8 at 1e-4 eV, factor ~1.6 tighter than Planck+BAO). Paper also constrains axion-gluon coupling Cg/fa and EDM coupling gd (AxionEDM), but pre-analysis hint of AxionPhoton matches Fig. 7. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density. Forecast CMB-S4 numbers mentioned but main result is observed limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 9))
